cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    project(lmx_knowledge_extra LANGUAGES C)
    set(LMX_KNOWLEDGE_STANDALONE ON)
    enable_testing()
endif()
option(LMX_KNOWLEDGE_EXTRA_BUILD_TESTS "Build retained knowledge/format checks" "${LMX_KNOWLEDGE_STANDALONE}")
set(LMX_KNOWLEDGE_VENDOR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../vendor" CACHE PATH "Local retained vendor inputs")
set(_knowledge_vendor "${LMX_KNOWLEDGE_VENDOR}")
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(NOT COMMAND lmx_c99_target)
    function(lmx_c99_target target)
        set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO)
        if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
            target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -pedantic-errors)
        endif()
    endfunction()
endif()

add_library(lmx_lbfgs STATIC "${_knowledge_vendor}/liblbfgs/lib/lbfgs.c")
add_library(LMX::lbfgs ALIAS lmx_lbfgs)
target_include_directories(lmx_lbfgs PUBLIC "${_knowledge_vendor}/liblbfgs/include")
# No USE_SSE: use the upstream portable ANSI arithmetic implementation.
lmx_c99_target(lmx_lbfgs)

# The upstream dmtx.c intentionally includes the other production .c files.
add_library(lmx_dmtx STATIC "${_knowledge_vendor}/libdmtx/dmtx.c")
add_library(LMX::dmtx ALIAS lmx_dmtx)
target_include_directories(lmx_dmtx PUBLIC "${_knowledge_vendor}/libdmtx")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_dmtx PRIVATE VERSION="0.7.9")
lmx_c99_target(lmx_dmtx)

# Archival regex option, not an intrinsic dependency of the LMX language.
# Only the byte/UTF-8 interpreter and POSIX facade are selected; no JIT,
# readline, compressed-file CLI, width-16/32 libraries, or online downloads.
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(BUILD_STATIC_LIBS ON)
set(PCRE2_BUILD_PCRE2_8 ON CACHE BOOL "Compact C99 profile" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_BUILD_PCRE2_16 OFF CACHE BOOL "Compact C99 profile" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_BUILD_PCRE2_32 OFF CACHE BOOL "Compact C99 profile" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_SUPPORT_JIT OFF CACHE BOOL "Compact C99 profile" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_SUPPORT_UNICODE ON CACHE BOOL "Compact C99 profile" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_BUILD_PCRE2GREP OFF CACHE BOOL "Compact C99 profile" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "Compact C99 profile" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_REBUILD_CHARTABLES OFF CACHE BOOL "Compact C99 profile" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_SUPPORT_LIBBZ2 OFF CACHE BOOL "Compact C99 profile" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_SUPPORT_LIBZ OFF CACHE BOOL "Compact C99 profile" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_SUPPORT_LIBREADLINE OFF CACHE BOOL "Compact C99 profile" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_SUPPORT_LIBEDIT OFF CACHE BOOL "Compact C99 profile" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${_knowledge_vendor}/pcre2" pcre2)
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/PCRE2C99.cmake")
lmx_pcre2_c99_errors("${_knowledge_vendor}/pcre2" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/pcre2_c99" _pcre2_errors_c99)
get_target_property(_pcre2_sources pcre2-8-static SOURCES)
list(FILTER _pcre2_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "(^|/)pcre2_error\\.c$")
set_property(TARGET pcre2-8-static PROPERTY SOURCES "${_pcre2_sources};${_pcre2_errors_c99}")
add_library(LMX::pcre2 ALIAS pcre2-8-static)
add_library(LMX::pcre2_posix ALIAS pcre2-posix-static)
lmx_c99_target(pcre2-8-static)
lmx_c99_target(pcre2-posix-static)

include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/Formats.cmake")
lmx_knowledge_formats()

if(UNIX)
    foreach(_target IN ITEMS lmx_lbfgs lmx_dmtx)
        target_link_libraries(${_target} PUBLIC m)
    endforeach()
endif()
add_library(lmx_knowledge_extra INTERFACE)
add_library(LMX::knowledge_extra ALIAS lmx_knowledge_extra)
target_link_libraries(lmx_knowledge_extra INTERFACE
    LMX::lbfgs LMX::dmtx LMX::pcre2 LMX::pcre2_posix LMX::tiff LMX::xls LMX::matio)

if(BUILD_TESTING OR LMX_KNOWLEDGE_STANDALONE OR LMX_KNOWLEDGE_EXTRA_BUILD_TESTS)
    foreach(_check IN ITEMS lbfgs dmtx pcre2 tiff xls matio)
        add_executable(lmx_knowledge_test_${_check} "tests/${_check}.c")
        lmx_c99_target(lmx_knowledge_test_${_check})
        target_link_libraries(lmx_knowledge_test_${_check} PRIVATE LMX::${_check})
        add_test(NAME knowledge_extra.${_check} COMMAND lmx_knowledge_test_${_check})
        file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/test_work/${_check}")
        set_tests_properties(knowledge_extra.${_check} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 15
            WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/test_work/${_check}")
    endforeach()
endif()
